body.name: BIC
body.sig: \[\operatorname{BIC}_n(E)=\begin{cases}-2\sup_{\Sigma\in\mathcal M(E)}\ell_n(\Sigma)+d_E\log n,&S_n\in\mathbb S^p_{++},\\ d_E\log n,&S_n\notin\mathbb S^p_{++},\end{cases}\qquad d_E=p+\sum_{j\in V}|\Pi^E_j|.\]
body.def: Total Gaussian BIC criterion with the likelihood branch used only for positive-definite sample covariance and a deterministic measurable fallback otherwise.
